requirement: A Particular reserves a published listing in one tap
expected: Reservar opens ¿Por cuántos días la reservas? with 1 día, 2, 3 and 5 días; one tap reserves from now, the toast gives the end in Lima time and the row shows Reservada hasta el … with Cambiar reserva and Quitar reserva.
steps: In Mis publicaciones press Reservar, then 2 días.

requirement: Only the owner's published Particular listing can be reserved
expected: Someone else's listing, a store listing, and a pending, hidden, sold or draft listing are refused with their own message (No puedes administrar esta publicación., Las tiendas separan unidades desde Inventario., Solo puedes reservar una publicación publicada.); the store tables never offer Reservar.
preconditions: Particular, a store owner and listings in each state
steps: Call set_listing_reservation for each; open Mis publicaciones and Inventario.

requirement: A period is 1, 2, 3 or 5 days, never longer
expected: Any other number is refused by the route (400 Elige 1, 2, 3 o 5 días.) and by the function; the table refuses a period over 5 days.
steps: Post reserve with days 4 and "2"; insert a 6-day row as postgres.

requirement: A reserved listing says so on its page
expected: The page shows the Reservado tag and Quien vende lo reservó para otra persona hasta el <weekday> <day> de <month> a las <time>; Avísame si se libera leads and WhatsApp is the secondary button, its message ending Vi que está reservado. Si se libera, ¿me avisas?
steps: Open it signed in as a buyer at 390 and 1366 px.

requirement: Reserved cards say Reservado in the catalog
expected: On /listados, a category page and after Ver 24 más, reserved cards carry the Reservado badge and the others none; a store card is never asked for.
preconditions: A reserved and a free Particular listing in one category
steps: Open /listados and the category page; press Ver 24 más.

requirement: The badge never slows or breaks the catalog
expected: With the catalog recovery switch on, past the optional budget or after three failed reads in ten seconds, the cards show no badge and the catalog loads as usual; the listing page still says Reservado.
preconditions: Reserved listing; LARIA_CATALOG_ENRICHMENT_DISABLED=true or a failing read
steps: Set the switch; open /listados and the listing.

requirement: Cached pages follow the period within a minute
expected: Starting, changing, ending (by the seller or the job) and closing a running period of a shown listing each record one page change; closing a period that already ended records none.
steps: Reserve, change, end; let the job end one; check laria_private.public_page_changes.

requirement: Cambiar reserva replaces the period
expected: A new 1, 2, 3 or 5-day period from now replaces the running one; the people waiting keep waiting.
preconditions: Reserved listing with one person waiting
steps: Press Cambiar reserva, then 5 días.

requirement: Quitar reserva frees it and tells the people waiting
expected: The tag goes at once; each person waiting gets one Se liberó una reserva notification and e-mail; the toast says how many were told; it counts as Sí, sigue disponible.
preconditions: Reserved listing with two people waiting
steps: Press Quitar reserva; open the buyers' Notificaciones and the e-mail log.

requirement: The seller is asked ¿Se vendió? once when the period ends
expected: Within a minute of the end the badge goes and the seller gets one notification, one e-mail ¿Se vendió “título”? (Responder → /mi-cuenta) and a Pendientes item; running the job again asks nothing more.
preconditions: Reserved listing whose period just ended
steps: Run laria_private.run_listing_reservations() twice; open the account home.

requirement: Sí, se vendió goes through the ordinary sold flow
expected: After the confirmation the listing is sold, the buyer choice opens at /mi-cuenta/transacciones/<id>, and each person waiting gets Se vendió: … in the app only.
preconditions: Ended period with one person waiting
steps: Press Sí, se vendió in Pendientes and confirm.

requirement: No, sigue disponible confirms availability and frees it
expected: The listing records an availability confirmation, the Pendientes item and the ended tag go, and the people waiting get one release notice and e-mail.
preconditions: Ended period with one person waiting
steps: Press No, sigue disponible in Pendientes.

requirement: No answer for 24 hours releases the listing
expected: 24 hours after the end the period is deleted, the people waiting hear once, the Pendientes item goes, and no availability confirmation is recorded.
steps: Run the job; open the account home and the buyer's Notificaciones.

requirement: Mis publicaciones shows the ended period's question
expected: An ended period reads Terminó la reserva · ¿Se vendió? with Se vendió, Sigue disponible and Reservar otra vez; Marcar vendida is hidden; how many people wait is shown.
steps: Open Mis publicaciones.

requirement: Reservar otra vez starts a new period
expected: A new period starts from now and the earlier ¿Se vendió? notification is marked read.
steps: Press Reservar otra vez, then 1 día.

requirement: A listing that leaves Published takes its period with it
expected: Within a minute of a listing being sold elsewhere, hidden, archived or hidden by an admin, its period is gone; the people waiting hear Se vendió in the app only if it sold, otherwise their requests end quietly.
steps: Sell one from its page, hide one, archive one; run the job.

requirement: Avísame si se libera turns on and off
expected: A signed-in buyer turns it on (Te avisaremos · Cancelar aviso) and off, and the state survives a reload; a visitor sees Ingresa para que te avisemos si se libera, which returns to the listing; the owner sees no button.
preconditions: Reserved listing; buyer, visitor and owner
steps: Press the button as each; reload.

requirement: A release request needs a running period and someone else's listing
expected: On a listing not reserved or whose period ended it is refused (Esta publicación ya no está reservada.); on one's own listing too (Es tu propia publicación.); the route answers 409 with the message.
steps: Call set_listing_release_watch or the PUT route on each.

requirement: Reservations and requests are private
expected: anon and authenticated cannot read or write either table; anon reads only running periods of published Particular listings, 200 ids at most; a seller reads only their own periods and a count of people waiting, never who.
steps: Query the tables and functions as each role.

requirement: Anonymizing an account removes its requests
expected: The account's release requests are deleted and counted as release_watches in the anonymization record.
steps: Anonymize the account.

requirement: The two e-mails read right and age out
expected: ¿Se vendió “título”? (Responder → /mi-cuenta; 3 days, priority 1) and Se liberó una publicación que esperabas (Ver publicación → the listing; 2 days, priority 2) are transactional, escape the title and carry no preference link.
steps: Render both; check email_max_age and email_priority.

requirement: Notifications name and link what happened
expected: ¿Se vendió? opens /mi-cuenta; Se liberó una reserva and Se vendió lo que esperabas open the listing.
steps: Open Notificaciones and press each.

requirement: The WhatsApp message on a reserved listing mentions it
expected: The opening message ends Vi que está reservado. Si se libera, ¿me avisas? instead of ¿Sigue disponible?
steps: Press Contactar por WhatsApp; read the wa.me text.

requirement: The end is a date in Lima, never «mañana»
expected: Ends read el jueves 29 de octubre a las 6:30 p. m. and a la 1:05 p. m. in America/Lima; the tag reads Reservada hasta el jue 29 oct.
steps: Reserve and read the page, the toast and the tag.

requirement: Hacer una oferta shows only where an offer makes sense
expected: The button shows on a published Particular listing with a price that is not reserved; never on a store listing, a sold or reserved listing, or one without a price.
steps: Open each listing.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § WhatsApp Contact Tracking (Hacer una oferta, proposed)

requirement: The sheet suggests three round amounts under the price
expected: Precio publicado: S/ 2,000 with S/ 1,900, S/ 1,800 and S/ 1,700 (95, 90 and 85 % rounded down to 100, 50, 10 or 5 by price); a chip fills Tu oferta and Tu mensaje shows the text; with no amount Enviar oferta por WhatsApp is disabled.
steps: Open the sheet; press each chip; clear the field.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § WhatsApp Contact Tracking (Hacer una oferta, proposed)

requirement: Enviar oferta por WhatsApp opens WhatsApp with the offer alone
expected: wa.me opens with the seller's number and Hola, te ofrezco S/ … por tu … publicado en Laria: <link>, without the quick questions; from S/ 1,000 the safety sheet shows first, once per browser; the contact is recorded like the main button's.
steps: Pick an amount and press Enviar oferta por WhatsApp.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § WhatsApp Contact Tracking (Hacer una oferta, proposed)

requirement: Laria never stores the offer
expected: No request, event, log or table carries the amount; /api/contact receives identity and source only.
steps: Send an offer with the network panel open; search the database and logs for the amount.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § WhatsApp Contact Tracking (Hacer una oferta, proposed)

requirement: A word for an offer at the price or far under it
expected: At or over the price: Es el precio publicado o más: también puedes escribir sin oferta.; under 60 %: Una oferta muy por debajo del precio suele quedarse sin respuesta.; both can still be sent.
steps: Type 2000, then 1000.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § WhatsApp Contact Tracking (Hacer una oferta, proposed)

requirement: The offer sheet works on a phone and with a keyboard
expected: A bottom sheet at 390 px and a centered dialog from 768 px, no horizontal scroll; Esc and Cerrar return focus to Hacer una oferta; the amount chips are pressed buttons; every control is at least 24 px.
steps: Open the sheet at 390 and 1366 px; use Tab, Esc and a screen reader.
